list.name: sector
list.label: Sector Filter
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  CASE
    WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Macro' THEN macro_sector
    WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Sector' THEN sector
    WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Industry' THEN industry
    ELSE basic_industry
  END AS __text,
  CASE
    WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Macro' THEN macro_sector
    WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Sector' THEN sector
    WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Industry' THEN industry
    ELSE basic_industry
  END AS __value
FROM index_constituents
WHERE index_name = 'NIFTY100'
ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_name, symbol)
    index_name,
    exchange,
    symbol,
    symbol_token,
    last_price,
    pct_intraday,
    pct_1d,
    pct_1w,
    volume_today,
    ts
  FROM symbol_perf_snapshot
  WHERE index_name = 'NIFTY100'
  ORDER BY index_name, symbol, ts DESC
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Macro' THEN c.macro_sector
      WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Sector' THEN c.sector
      WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Industry' THEN c.industry
      ELSE c.basic_industry
    END AS group_name,
    c.symbol AS label,
    COALESCE(c.weight, 1.0) AS size_value,
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN '$perf_mode' = 'intraday' THEN l.pct_intraday
        WHEN '$perf_mode' = '1d' THEN l.pct_1d
        ELSE l.pct_1w
      END,
      0::double precision
    ) AS color_value,
    COALESCE(l.last_price, 0::double precision) AS last_price,
    COALESCE(l.volume_today, 0::double precision) AS volume_today,
    COALESCE(c.weight, 0::double precision) AS weight,
    COALESCE(l.ts, now()) AS snapshot_ts
  FROM index_constituents c
  LEFT JOIN latest l
    ON l.symbol = c.symbol AND l.index_name = c.index_name
  WHERE c.index_name = 'NIFTY100'
    AND (
      '$sector' = 'All'
      OR (
        CASE
          WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Macro' THEN c.macro_sector
          WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Sector' THEN c.sector
          WHEN '$taxonomy' = 'Industry' THEN c.industry
          ELSE c.basic_industry
        END
      ) = '$sector'
    )
)
SELECT * FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'NIFTY100'::text AS group_name,
  'NO_DATA'::text AS label,
  1.0::double precision AS size_value,
  0.0::double precision AS color_value,
  0.0::double precision AS last_price,
  0.0::double precision AS volume_today,
  0.0::double precision AS weight,
  now() AS snapshot_ts
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base);

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (index_name, symbol)
    index_name,
    exchange,
    symbol,
    last_price,
    pct_intraday,
    pct_1d,
    pct_1w,
    volume_today,
    ts
  FROM symbol_perf_snapshot
  WHERE index_name = 'NIFTY100'
  ORDER BY index_name, symbol, ts DESC
)
SELECT
  l.symbol,
  l.last_price,
  CASE
    WHEN '$perf_mode' = 'intraday' THEN l.pct_intraday
    WHEN '$perf_mode' = '1d' THEN l.pct_1d
    ELSE l.pct_1w
  END AS return_pct,
  l.volume_today,
  l.ts
FROM latest l
ORDER BY return_pct DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20;

WITH latest AS (

    index_name,
    exchange,
    symbol,
    last_price,
    pct_intraday,
    pct_1d,
    pct_1w,
    volume_today,
    ts
  FROM symbol_perf_snapshot
  WHERE index_name = 'NIFTY100'
  ORDER BY index_name, symbol, ts DESC
)
SELECT
  l.symbol,
  l.last_price,
  CASE
    WHEN '$perf_mode' = 'intraday' THEN l.pct_intraday
    WHEN '$perf_mode' = '1d' THEN l.pct_1d
    ELSE l.pct_1w

  l.volume_today,
  l.ts
